title: Evidence playlist — morning triage notes
body:
Quick contextual note: this is a lightweight morning playlist for collecting evidence and triaging policy tasks. Not polished — my working list to move a few SOC2 items off my plate today.

Top goals (today):
- get AC-2 evidence packet for onboarding change requests uploaded to evidence repo
- finish vendor questionnaire for VaultPrime and mark follow-ups
- patch the one-line discrepancy in our encryption policy doc and snapshot version
- find last 90 days of privileged access logs for SRE on a2-gpu pool

Immediate checklist (order matters slightly):
1) AC-2 / user provisioning evidence
   - [ ] pull CSV of IAM invites/acceptances from 2026-06-01..2026-09-01 (query: `SELECT user, invite_time, accept_time, role FROM iam.invites WHERE org_id=redwood` )
   - [ ] export to evidence repo: `evidence/sec/ac-2/2026-09-07-invites.csv`
   - [ ] annotate rows where accept_time missing and link to ticket (SEC-412)
   - Notes: Miguel said he has a partial export in /tmp/invite-dump-aug; check slack thread #sec-tooling for context

2) Privileged access logs (SRE GPU pool)
   - [ ] ask SRE to export `priv_access` logs for nodes tagged `a2-gpu` from 2026-06-07 to 2026-09-07 (need full session IDs)
   - quick command for reference: `gsutil cp gs://redwood-logs/priv_access/2026-09-*.jsonl .` (confirm bucket path with Miguel)
   - [ ] attach one sanitized example to evidence packet (mask IPs + usernames)

3) Vendor intake: VaultPrime (new name in vendor registry)
   - [ ] finish questionnaire Q1-Q8 (my answers drafted; need legal to review Q4 about subprocessors)
   - [ ] capture SOC2-type certs they provided and hash them into evidence repo (`evidence/vendors/vaultprime/cert-hash.txt`)
   - [ ] flag unresolved datapath question for Priya: do they store backups in a different cloud region? (if yes -> extra control required)
   - quick notes: vendor portal link: https://vendors.redwood/vaultprime (portal requires SSO)

4) Policy TODOs
   - [ ] tiny wording change in Encryption Policy: replace "AES-256 or equivalent" with "AES-256 (or approved equivalent in crypto policy)" and add reference to KMS rotation schedule
   - [ ] update policy header with last-reviewed date: 2026-09-07 and increment version v1.3.1
   - question: do we want to call out disk-level encryption for ephemeral worker nodes explicitly? add as a follow-up if time

5) Evidence packaging + naming conventions (finalize today)
   - standard: `evidence/<control>/<yyy-mm-dd>-<owner>-<artifact-type>.<ext>`
   - examples I will create: `evidence/ac-2/2026-09-07-anya-invites.csv`, `evidence/ac-6/2026-09-07-priv-log-sample.jsonl`
   - [ ] run small audit script that validates filenames and generates manifest.json (script: tools/evidence/validate_manifest.sh)

Open questions / quick blocks
- Legal review for VaultPrime Q4 (subprocessors) — Priya will ping legal and loop me in (Slack: @pri_legal). If legal requests contract changes, we need to escalate to procurement.
- Which SRE is owner for `a2-gpu` export? Miguel thinks it's Samir, but I need confirmation.
- Is the encryption policy wording change significant enough to notify infra? I suspect minor, but will mention in #infra-policy for awareness.

Meeting notes (9:30 standup with Sec team)
- Miguel: will hand off invite CSV by 11:00
- Priya: legal ping queued for VaultPrime; expects reply EOD
- Samir: privileged logs export may take until EOD due to archival retrieval
- Action: I will create PR for encryption policy draft by 13:00 and tag infra + legal

Micro-tasks (5–15 minute items)
- [ ] copy sample log to evidence/preview and redact (done iteratively)
- [ ] attach PR link to SEC-412
- [ ] update Confluence short note (Access Control - draft) with pointer to evidence bundle

Notes-to-self (fragments):
- keep one local copy in ~/work/sec-evidence/ until manifest validated
- avoid using real user emails in uploaded artifacts; use hashed_email field (sha256)
- remember to export artifact checksums (sha256) and include in manifest

End-of-day goals for this playlist:
- evidence packet AC-2 complete and uploaded, manifest generated
- vendor intake for VaultPrime at least submitted to legal with artifacts attached
- encryption policy PR open, minimal infra impact

If stuck: escalate via #sec-escalations or DM Miguel/ Priya.

Reference quick links:
- Confluence: Access Control - draft (search)
- Jira: SEC-412
- Evidence repo path: git@github.com:redwood-inference/evidence.git

Random thought: maybe batch similar small evidence tasks into a weekly "evidence playlist" so we only spin up archival exports once per week rather than ad-hoc. Tagging as follow-up for next week's planning.

-- anya
